Balances.description: Which balance-sheet amounts the ratios use (SPEC-0007 R2). No default: the analyst chooses.

oneOf.description: Balances at the end of the period (`closing`).
Average of the opening and closing balances: (opening + closing) / 2. Needs `opening`.

DebtBasis.description: What D measures in the leverage form of the ROE decomposition. No default.

oneOf.description: Net financial position (gross debt minus cash and other items, as the analyst defines it).

LeverageInputs.description:
Inputs of the leverage form ROE = [ROI + (ROI − i) × D/E] × (1 − t). The debt D itself is
given in the balance sheets (`debt`), so the balance convention applies to it.

debt_basis.description:
Basis of D: `gross_financial_debt` or `net_financial_position`. Required when `leverage`
is given, no default.

financial_charges.description:
Financial charges of the period, in currency units; i = financial charges / D. Absent
or null: not given.

pre_tax_income.description: Income before taxes of the period, in currency units. Absent or null: not given.

taxes.description:
Income taxes of the period, in currency units; t = taxes / pre-tax income. Absent or
null: not given.

OperatingReturnBase.description: The capital on which the operating return (ROI) and the capital turnover are measured.

oneOf.description: Operating invested capital (`invested_capital` in the balance sheets).
Total assets (`total_assets` in the balance sheets).

ProfitabilityBalances.description:
Balance-sheet amounts at one date, in currency units. Every amount is optional: absent or
null means not given, and the ratios that need it are not computed.

debt.description:
Debt D of the leverage form, in currency units, on the basis chosen in
`leverage.debt_basis`. Used when `leverage` is given; not used otherwise.

equity.description: Shareholders' equity, in currency units. May be negative.

invested_capital.description:
Operating invested capital, in currency units. Used when `operating_return_base` is
`invested_capital` (ROI and capital turnover); not used otherwise.

ProfitabilityIncome.description:
Flows of the period, in currency units. Every amount is optional: absent or null means not
given, and the ratios that need it are not computed (never taken as zero).

ebit.description: EBIT (operating result) of the period, in currency units.

ebitda.description:
EBITDA of the period, in currency units, as defined in `ebitda_definition` (the EBITDA
margin needs both).

net_income.description: Net income of the period, in currency units.

revenue.description: Revenue of the period, in currency units.

description:
Input of `ratios.profitability` (version 2). Only `balances` and `operating_return_base`
are required; each ratio is computed when its own amounts are given (SPEC-0007 R7).

balances.description: Balances used by the ratios: `closing`, or `average` of opening and closing.

closing.description: Balance sheet at the end of the period. Absent or null: no amount given.

income_statement.description: Flows of the period. Absent or null: no flow given.

leverage.description:
Inputs of the leverage form of the ROE decomposition. Absent: the leverage form is not
defined and the other ratios are computed.

opening.description:
Balance sheet at the start of the period, used with average balances; not used with
closing balances. Absent with average balances: the balance-sheet ratios are not
computed.

operating_return_base.description: Capital on which ROI and the capital turnover are measured.
